data.key: Shadowbound Corruption ~ Refuge in Pain Gift
data.name: Refuge in Pain Gift
data.description: Pain invigorates you. Whenever you take an amount of damage greater than or equal to three times your character level from a single attack, you gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, and skill checks for 1 round. If you have the stain from the weaver of lies manifestation, these bonuses are profane bonuses instead.
